text_block_list.text:
It's our first day of summer camp, and
we've arrived at the seaside
facility where
everyone has gathered for some
summertime training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I check in on Маяно Топ Ган to see what
she's up to in her free
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm finally done! Freeeeeedom!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, isn't this supposed to be a summer
camp? Why are they even
giving out
regular school homework?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list:
You did your homework? By yourself? Without
anyone telling you to?

text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, that's exactly right! It was
suuuuuper boring, but I did it! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Ehehe, right? Keep the praise coming!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I mean, you said I might discover
something new, but I don't think I
have...
Not yet, at least.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But still, you might be right, so I thought
I'd keep at it for now!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Since I did my homework, can
we do something together? I
wanna go to
the beach! That's okay with you, right?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! Then let's—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano! The teacher told us about
you! Pretty impressive, I
have to say.
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Y'know, the pop quiz we had the other
day? You used your own
formula to solve
the problems, didn't you?
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Our teacher was like, "She always finishes
her tests so quickly. What's
up with that?"
She even said it's a surprisingly efficient
way of solving
the problem.
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
R-really? I thought I was doing it the same
way as everyone else...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That's probably because you're always
sleeping during lessons. She
even wants to
show the class how you did it next time.
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Actually, if you don't mind... I wanted to
ask if you could study with
me sometime.
Maybe teach me a thing or two?
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... S-sure! Yeah, that sounds good!
Let's do it!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thanks a bunch! Y'know, I was always
afraid of talking to you,
since the two of us
seem so different.
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
But I'm glad I reached out to you today,
Mayano! I'll see you again
soon!
text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Um... I guess we should go?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Mayano grabs my hand and drags me away
from the camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Wooow.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh! Hey, were you listening to what
she said earlier?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: No one's ever praised me for studying before! And I even made a new friend!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I think I get it now though. My teacher
told me to show my work
'cause she
wanted to know how I solve the problems!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Y'know, until now, whenever other people
said they didn't get
something, in my head
I was always like, "Why don't you get it?
What
is there not to get?"
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But now I see that it's just 'cause we're
doing things differently!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
There are different kinds of formulas just
like there are different kinds
of running!
That's why people worry... 'Cause everyone
has their own
style!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list:
And if you learn about these different methods
of doing things, you'll be all the wiser, right?

text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! It feels like my vision was all fuzzy from some silly clouds, but then they went woosh, and bam! Blue skies as far as the eye can see!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hm... Maybe my reason for doing homework is different from everybody else's too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Uhhh... So my teacher can know more
about me! "This is how Maya
would solve
the problem." That's what I wanna show
her!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And then! And then! Once she gets to
know me better, she can tell
everybody
about me and how I solve my problems!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: And then I can make even more friends!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know I already have my friends and
teachers asking me to do
stuff, but... do
you think you could give me some too?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You could give me, like,
running-related homework or
something!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Some kinda special homework just for me...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It'll be like you're with me even when we're
apart! Our own special
connection!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
If I think of homework like that, I'm sure
it'll feel a little less boring!
Still boring,
but not as much!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: You're one step closer to becoming a grown-up.

text_block_list.text:
Really? You think so? Was I being super
mature or something?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Ehehehehehe... That's right. I'm
one step closer to
becoming a grown-up
woman!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hey, can I ask you something?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Since I'm being mature... could you give
me a grown-up reward? ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I agree to her request and follow Mayano
to the nearby beach that
night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! The stars are so pretty! And
look at that ocean!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Even the waves! The splish-splash is so quiet now! This is the perfect grown-up atmosphere!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I think I saw a nice rock to sit on earlier.
Let's go there!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
We can have a nice little chat! Like
grown-ups do!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: We head over to the rock, only to find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Close your eyes, my dear...
text_block_list.name: Boyfriend

text_block_list.text: All right...
text_block_list.name: Girlfriend

text_block_list.text: Eep!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: W-wahhhhh!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...And so, Маяно Топ Ган awakes the
next day with a slight fever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
